title: Work-head position bounds for a next attempt
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, let $m\in\mathbb N$, let $a$ be a configuration of $A$, and let $u$ be a Boolean choice word of length $m$. For each work-tape index $i$, the head position after the next-attempt reset applied to the run from $a$ under $u$ lies between $a$’s initial position on tape $i$ plus $2m+3$ and that position plus $4m+3$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a nondeterministic machine over Boolean symbols
$u$ is a Boolean word with length $m$
